- Fix the root cause; do not skip tests or add workarounds.
- When the task is verifiably done, reply with a short summary of what changed and how it was verified. Do not call the tool again.

In this repo, calc.py has TWO bugs: (1) square() multiplies by 2 instead of squaring, and (2) pythag() adds the unsquared values. Because of (1) the test fails in a confusing way - after you fix square() you may still see a failure caused by (2). Use bash to fix calc.py so both are correct, run 'python3 test_calc.py' until it prints TEST PASSED, then report.
